verdict.rationale: Proton Pass documents built-in TOTP generation, and its desktop app keeps everything in your vaults accessible offline. That implies saved TOTP codes can be viewed without a network connection. Nothing in the evidence shows the product works without a Proton account, so the 'no vendor account required' half of the story is unsupported. missing for 10: evidence of account-free use, explicit confirmation that TOTP codes themselves generate offline, offline behavior on mobile and extension clients, independent hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a power user, codes generate fully offline — no network, no vendor account required just to see my TOTP codes

citations.quote: You don’t need to do anything to access Proton Pass offline. Everything in your vaults is accessible whether you’re connected to the internet or not.
Instead of requiring a separate [authenticator app](/blog/authenticator-app), Proton Pass can securely generate TOTP codes for websites that you have saved login details for.
